purpose: Test whether retaining complete producer products and per-module materializer receipts removes real edit latency.

contrasts.old_B_new_B: Same producer flag, no graph, frozen old and new binaries; isolate this continuation.
contrasts.new_A_B_C: A existing caches, B shared producer plus materializer receipts, C B plus reactive graph; do not count B gains as graph gains.

rules: Hypothetical weights are sensitivity calculations, not measured user request frequencies.
Profiled diagnostics and unprofiled full request measurements remain separate.
Every edited request starts from a validated named parent; preserve all preparation rows.
All successful requests execute current independent Verify; O2 runs validate complete native outcomes.
No increased limits, changed cache policy, reduced optimization or source replacement.
Single-block and cross-window cost differences diagnose mechanisms, not accepted speedup.
Retain failed runs; report cold/broad/error/fallback separately from incremental edits.
Require actual shared Core/maps, sparse materializer walks and unchanged CFG recomputation before performance claims.
